# Redition Pharma Ltd. - Complete Dossier

> Comprehensive pharmaceutical technical monograph, regulatory compliance profile, formulation specifications, and institutional supply documentation for Redition Pharma Ltd., Surat, Gujarat, India.

## Company Overview
- **Legal Entity**: Redition Pharma Ltd.
- **Operating Brand**: Redition Pharma
- **Corporate Office**: 101, 1st Floor, Bhumi Park Society, Punagam Chorasi Bombay Market, Surat, Gujarat 395010, India
- **Certifications**: WHO-GMP, Revised Schedule M, FSSAI (Central Lic. No. 12116801000249), ISO 9001:2015, GLP compliant
- **Direct Trade Desk**: trade@reditionpharma.com
- **Direct Dispatch Coordinator**: +91 79877 79819
- **Official Website**: https://reditionpharma.com

## Pharmaceutical Products & Formulations

### 1. ADNOSINE-108 Tablets
- **Link**: [ADNOSINE-108 Monograph](https://reditionpharma.com/product/adnosine-108)
- **Active Ingredients**: Adenosine 5-Monophosphate (AMP) 2.5mg, Decarboxylated L-Arginine 2.5mg, L-Carnosine 25.0mg
- **Dosage Form**: Film-Coated Tablet
- **Packaging**: 10 x 1 x 10 Tablets in Alu-Alu Blister Strip
- **Mechanism of Action**: Direct precursor replenishment of cellular adenosine triphosphate (ATP), endothelial nitric-oxide microvascular perfusion, and inhibition of advanced glycation end-products (AGEs) along peripheral nerves.

### 2. MACSINE-109 Tablets
- **Link**: [MACSINE-109 Monograph](https://reditionpharma.com/product/macsine-109)
- **Active Ingredients**: Alpha Lipoic Acid 100mg, Benfotiamine 100mg, Calcium Carbonate 500mg, Chromium Picolinate 200mcg, Folic Acid 1.5mg, Inositol 100mg, Methylcobalamin 1500mcg, Pyridoxine HCl 3mg, Vitamin D3 1000 IU
- **Dosage Form**: Film-Coated Tablet
- **Packaging**: 10 x 1 x 10 Blister Pack
- **Mechanism of Action**: 9-in-1 multi-pathway neurotrophic complex supporting myelin sheath repair, reducing endoneurial lipid peroxidation, and relieving diabetic peripheral neuropathy paresthesia.

### 3. PREDY-NT 37.5/10 Tablets
- **Link**: [PREDY-NT Monograph](https://reditionpharma.com/product/predy-nt)
- **Active Ingredients**: Pregabalin Sustained Release 37.5mg, Nortriptyline Hydrochloride 10mg
- **Classification**: Prescription Medicine (Schedule H)
- **Dosage Form**: Sustained-Release Film-Coated Tablet
- **Packaging**: 10 x 10 Tablets in Alu-Alu Strip
- **Mechanism of Action**: Synergistic alpha-2-delta voltage-gated calcium channel modulation by sustained-release Pregabalin with central descending noradrenergic/serotonergic inhibition by Nortriptyline for 24-hour nerve pain relief.

### 4. QLONG-GOLD Tablets
- **Link**: [QLONG-GOLD Monograph](https://reditionpharma.com/product/qlong-gold)
- **Active Ingredients**: L-Arginine, L-Citrulline, Fenugreek Extract, Biopeprine, Tribulus Terrestris, Hypericum Perforatum, Pine Bark Extract, Mucuna Pruriens, Zinc, Vitamin D2
- **Dosage Form**: Coated Tablet
- **Packaging**: 10 x 10 Tablets
- **Mechanism of Action**: Dual nitric oxide precursors with piperine bioavailability enhancement for microvascular tone, mitochondrial vitality, and adaptogenic physical performance.

### 5. ADNOCAR-DS Syrup
- **Link**: [ADNOCAR-DS Monograph](https://reditionpharma.com/product/adnocar-ds)
- **Active Ingredients (per 5ml)**: L-Carnosine 200mg, DHA 550mg, EPA 200mg, Vitamin B6 150mg, Vitamin D3 1500 IU, Co-Enzyme Q10 100mg
- **Dosage Form**: 200ml Liquid Oral Suspension (Flavoured Mango Base)
- **FSSAI License**: 12116801000249
- **Mechanism of Action**: High-potency cognitive and synaptogenic supplementation providing omega-3 fatty acids, carnosine neuroprotection, and mitochondrial Co-Q10 bioenergetics for pediatric speech, attention, and neural plasticity.

## Quality Assurance & Compliance

- **4-Tier Analytical Validation**: [Quality Policy Details](https://reditionpharma.com/#quality)
- **HPLC Monograph Testing**: Raw APIs tested to ≥ 99.5% monograph purity before dispensing.
- **Cleanroom Standards**: WHO-GMP Class 100 (ISO Class 5 / Grade C/D) environment with 0.3µm HEPA filtration.
- **Stability Testing**: Continuous validation under ICH Zone IVb climate chambers (30°C / 75% RH).
- **Statutory Batch Release**: Certificate of Analysis (COA) containing ICP-MS heavy metal screen, microbiological purity, and dissolution assay released with every batch.
